transport: Plugs into any product's VE.Direct port and republishes it over BLE. Two distinct BLE behaviours: (a) live-data advertisement, which is the victron-ble-instant-readout record above, requiring dongle firmware 2.41 or later and explicit activation; (b) a connected GATT session used by the VictronConnect app, for which Victron publishes no specification.

gotchas: This is an accessory, not a solar-charger dialect. It exists in the catalogue because it is the ONLY way to get any wireless telemetry out of a BlueSolar MPPT, which has no built-in Bluetooth. It is listed by one Quebec retailer.

It occupies the VE.Direct port. Once the dongle is fitted, a wired gateway cannot also read that port — the choice is BLE advertisement (fewer fields, encrypted, needs the key) or a serial cable (full text and HEX), not both.
The connected VictronConnect protocol is undocumented. Do not plan a driver against it. The advertisement path is the only specified one.

Separately, product-id note 4 in the MPPT HEX doc records that on the phased-out SmartSolar 150/100 (0xA051) and 150/85 (0xA052) the internal Bluetooth is multiplexed with the VE.Direct port: using the VE.Direct port disables the built-in Bluetooth. Newer models do not have this restriction.
